problem_type: Header navigation affordances must use the project leave owner
symptom: Clicking the Nomi header brand selects text instead of returning to the project library.
direct_cause: Both platform headers wrap NomiBrand in a non-interactive span; the separate breadcrumb home action is hidden on narrow screens. Actual browser validation also found subscription close incorrectly required the already-released project authority.
class_root: The stable brand affordance has no semantic navigation control connected to the existing save-before-leave lifecycle.
affected_population: Web, macOS/Linux and Windows header layouts, including narrow screens
entry_points: Nomi header brand click and keyboard activation
invariants: Every workspace header provides an accessible brand home button.
Home uses the existing backToLibrary callback and project persistence lifecycle.

door_reduction.why_not: Both platform header doors provide the same project navigation callback. Design lab, agent message branding and onboarding intro are display-only brand consumers and must remain non-navigating.

generality_proof: Both header platform branches use semantic buttons with the same save-before-leave callback, so keyboard, pointer and narrow layouts converge on the existing project owner.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Expose home through the supplied project leave callback in native/web headers.
Use the same callback for the Windows title bar.
Close only the owning browser subscription after project release, without cancelling server execution.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Non-Windows brand span and hidden narrow breadcrumb reproduce the reported symptom.
The same static span prevents activation on Windows.
No project is active in this display-only intro.

recurrence.reason: The static header brand reproduces across platform and viewport entries.
same_class_scan: node scripts/door-map.mjs NomiBrand found five consumers, two workspace headers.
Read NomiStudioApp.leaveProject and useProjectLeaveAction: save, unbind and release happen before library navigation.

prevention.invariant: Workspace brand controls invoke the supplied canonical project leave callback.
prevention.failure_mode: When no leave callback is supplied the brand control is disabled; save failures retain the project via the existing leave owner.
prevention.strategy: Replace static spans in both header layouts with existing WorkbenchButton controls.

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove static header brand wrappers; retain display-only branding elsewhere.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Uses existing WorkbenchButton and project leave lifecycle.

migration: No stored data or paths change.
residual_risks: Actual browser save, home and reopen verification pending.
internal_only_reason: This is an internal UI and persistence ownership contract; no dependency change is needed.
